name: Music Assistant
description: Full Music Assistant controller: now playing, queue, players and grouping, library browse and search.

options.label: Music Assistant URL
options.help: Address of the Music Assistant server, e.g. http://192.168.1.25:8095 or https://music.example.com.

options.label: API token
options.help: Create a long-lived token in Music Assistant under Settings > Profile and paste it here.

options.label: Default player
options.help: Optional player name to control when the page opens. Blank remembers the last-used player.
